spans.text: I get the feeling that I'm going to find something really scary so please get behind me first in case I can't protect you Persicaria...

units.rawText: Relax, no need to be so tense. I see her, it's Puzzle... hm?
units.displayText: Relax, no need to be so tense. I see her, it's Puzzle... hm?

spans.text: Relax, no need to be so tense. I see her, it's Puzzle... hm?

units.rawText: Within the limited range of her illumination, Sol and Persicaria see Puzzle lying motionless on the ground.
units.displayText: Within the limited range of her illumination, Sol and Persicaria see Puzzle lying motionless on the ground.

spans.text: Within the limited range of her illumination, Sol and Persicaria see Puzzle lying motionless on the ground.

units.rawText: ...Okay, she hasn't become super gross yet. Could it be that those squishy noises weren't made by her?
units.displayText: ...Okay, she hasn't become super gross yet. Could it be that those squishy noises weren't made by her?

spans.text: ...Okay, she hasn't become super gross yet. Could it be that those squishy noises weren't made by her?

units.rawText: That might not be. Let's prepare to defend ourselves and then slowly move in.
units.displayText: That might not be. Let's prepare to defend ourselves and then slowly move in.

spans.text: That might not be. Let's prepare to defend ourselves and then slowly move in.

units.rawText: Psssh.
units.displayText: Psssh.

spans.text: Psssh.

units.rawText: Something darts past and snatches away the operands in Sol's hand, plunging the surroundings back into darkness.
units.displayText: Something darts past and snatches away the operands in Sol's hand, plunging the surroundings back into darkness.

spans.text: Something darts past and snatches away the operands in Sol's hand, plunging the surroundings back into darkness.

units.rawText: AAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!!!!
units.displayText: AAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!!!!

spans.text: AAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!!!!

units.rawText: What was that?! Sol, did you see it?
units.displayText: What was that?! Sol, did you see it?

spans.text: What was that?! Sol, did you see it?

units.rawText: I didn't! I didn't, what was that just now?!
units.displayText: I didn't! I didn't, what was that just now?!

spans.text: I didn't! I didn't, what was that just now?!

units.rawText: No, no, I can't hear anything clearly this way, I need to calm down...
units.displayText: No, no, I can't hear anything clearly this way, I need to calm down...

spans.text: No, no, I can't hear anything clearly this way, I need to calm down...

units.rawText: Sol slowly calms herself down and focuses on listening to the noises around her.
units.displayText: Sol slowly calms herself down and focuses on listening to the noises around her.

spans.text: Sol slowly calms herself down and focuses on listening to the noises around her.

units.rawText: The workshop is silent. Even those squishy noises have vanished.
units.displayText: The workshop is silent. Even those squishy noises have vanished.

spans.text: The workshop is silent. Even those squishy noises have vanished.

units.rawText: Myaa–
units.displayText: Myaa–

spans.text: Myaa–

units.rawText: A cat meows ferociously from behind Sol and Persicaria.
units.displayText: A cat meows ferociously from behind Sol and Persicaria.

spans.text: A cat meows ferociously from behind Sol and Persicaria.

units.rawText: Sol almost jumps, and then whirls around while putting her swords up.
units.displayText: Sol almost jumps, and then whirls around while putting her swords up.

spans.text: Sol almost jumps, and then whirls around while putting her swords up.

units.rawText: Clang!
units.displayText: Clang!

spans.text: Clang!

units.rawText: Ugh...! Something hit me...
units.displayText: Ugh...! Something hit me...

spans.text: Ugh...! Something hit me...

units.rawText: Myaa!!
units.displayText: Myaa!!

spans.text: Myaa!!

units.rawText: The meowing is coming from diagonally behind her this time. Sol swiftly moves to block, and the crisp sound of another impact fills the air.
units.displayText: The meowing is coming from diagonally behind her this time. Sol swiftly moves to block, and the crisp sound of another impact fills the air.

spans.text: The meowing is coming from diagonally behind her this time. Sol swiftly moves to block, and the crisp sound of another impact fills the air.

units.rawText: What the hell was that, can the Entropics meow now?!
units.displayText: What the hell was that, can the Entropics meow now?!

spans.text: What the hell was that, can the Entropics meow now?!

units.rawText: Are there really Entropics like that?
units.displayText: Are there really Entropics like that?

spans.text: Are there really Entropics like that?

units.rawText: Compared to Entropics, I've heard more ghost stories involving cats.
units.displayText: Compared to Entropics, I've heard more ghost stories involving cats.

spans.text: Compared to Entropics, I've heard more ghost stories involving cats.

units.rawText: Ahhhhhhhh don't scare me any more Persicariaaaaa!
units.displayText: Ahhhhhhhh don't scare me any more Persicariaaaaa!

spans.text: Ahhhhhhhh don't scare me any more Persicariaaaaa!

units.rawText: After griping for a bit, Sol finds that it helps her calm down in this unusual battle.
units.displayText: After griping for a bit, Sol finds that it helps her calm down in this unusual battle.

spans.text: After griping for a bit, Sol finds that it helps her calm down in this unusual battle.

units.rawText: She slows her clock speed to the minimum, and her senses expand like never before, enough to pick up on all the movements around her.
units.displayText: She slows her clock speed to the minimum, and her senses expand like never before, enough to pick up on all the movements around her.

spans.text: She slows her clock speed to the minimum, and her senses expand like never before, enough to pick up on all the movements around her.

units.rawText: There is a faint squishing sound of something rubbing against something. The noise of Persicaria's healing device running. The wind. Nearby scraping.
units.displayText: There is a faint squishing sound of something rubbing against something. The noise of Persicaria's healing device running. The wind. Nearby scraping.

spans.text: There is a faint squishing sound of something rubbing against something. The noise of Persicaria's healing device running. The wind. Nearby scraping.

units.rawText: (...Something else is moving besides that cat.)
units.displayText: ...Something else is moving besides that cat.

spans.text: ...Something else is moving besides that cat.

units.rawText: (But the enemy is hidden, while we're in the open, so we're at a disadvantage... Where's the nearest window?)
units.displayText: But the enemy is hidden, while we're in the open, so we're at a disadvantage... Where's the nearest window?

spans.text: But the enemy is hidden, while we're in the open, so we're at a disadvantage... Where's the nearest window?

units.rawText: (Ah, I think I see a light, it should be here... I can't let myself be found out.)
units.displayText: Ah, I think I see a light, it should be here... I can't let myself be found out.

spans.text: Ah, I think I see a light, it should be here... I can't let myself be found out.

units.rawText: Persicaria, I can't see anything!
units.displayText: Persicaria, I can't see anything!

spans.text: Persicaria, I can't see anything!

units.rawText: I'm so scared, where are you, please let me hold your hand...
units.displayText: I'm so scared, where are you, please let me hold your hand...

spans.text: I'm so scared, where are you, please let me hold your hand...

units.rawText: Despite saying this, Sol quietly moves in the opposite direction.
units.displayText: Despite saying this, Sol quietly moves in the opposite direction.

spans.text: Despite saying this, Sol quietly moves in the opposite direction.

units.rawText: (...This is it!)
units.displayText: ...This is it!

spans.text: ...This is it!

units.rawText: Sol grabs the curtain covering the big window. However, at almost the same time, she hears the sound of the wind from behind her.
units.displayText: Sol grabs the curtain covering the big window. However, at almost the same time, she hears the sound of the wind from behind her.

spans.text: Sol grabs the curtain covering the big window. However, at almost the same time, she hears the sound of the wind from behind her.

units.rawText: (Crap! Was it a trap?!)
units.displayText: Crap! Was it a trap?!

spans.text: Crap! Was it a trap?!

units.rawText: Myaa!
units.displayText: Myaa!

spans.text: Myaa!

units.rawText: By just a hair's breadth, something bounds out of the darkness and blocks the hit directed at Sol.
units.displayText: By just a hair's breadth, something bounds out of the darkness and blocks the hit directed at Sol.

spans.text: By just a hair's breadth, something bounds out of the darkness and blocks the hit directed at Sol.

units.rawText: The moonlight streams in through the window, illuminating the place, and the attacker hidden in the darkness no longer has concealment.
units.displayText: The moonlight streams in through the window, illuminating the place, and the attacker hidden in the darkness no longer has concealment.

spans.text: The moonlight streams in through the window, illuminating the place, and the attacker hidden in the darkness no longer has concealment.

units.rawText: ...So it was you?
units.displayText: ...So it was you?

spans.text: ...So it was you?

units.rawText: The form that appears in the cold white light is hideously distorted, but also incredibly familiar.
units.displayText: The form that appears in the cold white light is hideously distorted, but also incredibly familiar.

spans.text: The form that appears in the cold white light is hideously distorted, but also incredibly familiar.

units.rawText: I didn't think you were that capable, Puzzle.
units.displayText: I didn't think you were that capable, Puzzle.

spans.text: I didn't think you were that capable, Puzzle.

units.rawText: A soft, multicolored cat wobbles as it retreats back to Sol's side.
units.displayText: A soft, multicolored cat wobbles as it retreats back to Sol's side.

spans.text: A soft, multicolored cat wobbles as it retreats back to Sol's side.

units.rawText: Ranko... So it was you-myaa...
units.displayText: Ranko... So it was you-myaa...

spans.text: Ranko... So it was you-myaa...
